ev.q: In 2014, 66% of infants who survived to age 1 year were delivered at full term or later
Fifty-eight percent of infants who died before age 1 year were delivered at <32 weeks gestation
66% of infants who survived to age 1 year were delivered at full term or later
compared with 16% of infants who died before reaching age 1 year
Source: National Vital Statistics System, Linked Birth and Infant Death Data.
